passage.text: From next month, our bank at the mall will have new opening hours.
passage.reading: frəm ˈnɛkst ˈmʌnθ, aʊr ˈbæŋk ət ðə ˈmɔːl wɪl ˈhæv ˈnuː ˈoʊpənɪŋ ˌaʊərz.

passage.text: We will be open from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday to Saturday.
passage.reading: wiː wɪl bi ˈoʊpən frəm ˈtɛn ˌeɪˈɛm tə ˈsɛvən ˌpiːˈɛm, ˈmʌndeɪ tə ˈsætərdeɪ.

passage.text: On Sunday, we will be open from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m.
passage.reading: ɑːn ˈsʌndeɪ, wiː wɪl bi ˈoʊpən frəm ɪˈlɛvən ˌeɪˈɛm tə ˈfaɪv ˌpiːˈɛm.

passage.text: With online banking, you can check your balance and transfer money on your phone.
passage.reading: wɪð ˌɑːnlaɪn ˈbæŋkɪŋ, juː kən ˈtʃɛk jʊr ˈbæləns ənd trænsˈfɜːr ˈmʌni ɑːn jʊr ˈfoʊn.

passage.text: This service is free, and it's available 24 hours a day.
passage.reading: ðɪs ˈsɜːrvɪs ɪz ˈfriː, ənd ɪts əˈveɪləbəl ˌtwɛnti ˈfɔːr ˈaʊərz ə ˈdeɪ.

passage.text: To start, please come to the front desk with your ID card.
passage.reading: tə ˈstɑːrt, ˈpliːz ˈkʌm tə ðə ˌfrʌnt ˈdɛsk wɪð jʊr ˌaɪˈdiː ˌkɑːrd.
